description: **The adaptive health-messaging engine for apps and agents — federally-sourced, audience-safe facts, lists & tips, keyless to try.** Call `lookup_health_fact` from any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, the OpenAI Agents SDK) with no API key and no signup, and get a CDC/NIH/USPSTF/SAMHSA-sourced fact, list, or tip with its source link. The full Signal API — sequenced cued-message streams over a 16,500+ library of federally-sourced facts, lists & tips that advance on each patient's response, each with a receptivity score + audience-safety verdict — is a free sandbox key away. Display-mode, no PHI. Not medical advice. Try it → https://uphealth.us/signal/try

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
